    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the uniform rectangular target (color 0 in the provided task).
    target = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    if not target:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in target), max(r for r, c in target)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in target), max(c for r, c in target)
    # The patterned object is the non-background, non-target content above/elsewhere.
    colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, grid[0][0])}
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] in colors]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            # Copy the source pattern into the target, reflected left-to-right.
            out[r][c] = grid[sr0 + (r - r0)][sc1 - (c - c0)]
